extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and prospective authors in combinatorics considering submission to Annals of Combinatorics
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on the topical scope and editorial emphasis for manuscripts submitted to the Annals of Combinatorics. Identifies in-scope subject tracks and the kinds of contributions the journal seeks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outstanding contributions to combinatorics
rubrics_metrics.description: Publishes outstanding contributions to combinatorics with a particular focus on algebraic and analytic combinatorics, as well as the areas of graph and matroid theory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should present work of high quality and significance in combinatorics; preference is for papers that make strong, original contributions within the stated focus areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for new developments and current-interest topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Special regard will be given to new developments and topics of current interest to the community represented by our editorial board.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority is given to novel results and emerging directions that are timely and of interest to the journal's editorial community; authors should emphasize novelty and relevance to current research trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Algebraic Combinatorics (in-scope topics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerative combinatorics, symmetric functions, Schubert calculus / Combinatorial Hopf algebras, cluster algebras, Lie algebras, root systems, Coxeter groups / Discrete geometry, tropical geometry / Discrete dynamical systems / Posets and lattices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions addressing any of these subtopics belong to the algebraic combinatorics track; papers should align their main contributions with one or more listed areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analytic and Algorithmic Combinatorics (in-scope topics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Asymptotic analysis of counting sequences / Bijective combinatorics / Univariate and multivariable singularity analysis / Combinatorics and differential equations / Resolution of hard combinatorial problems by making essential use of computers / Advanced methods for evaluating counting sequences or combinatorial constants / Complexity and decidability aspects of combinatorial sequences / Combinatorial aspects of the analysis of algorithms
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This track includes both analytic (asymptotic, singularity) and algorithmic/computational approaches; work that relies on significant computational methods or addresses complexity/decidability questions is in scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphs and Matroids (in-scope topics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Structural graph theory, graph minors, graph sparsity, decompositions and colorings / Planar graphs and topological graph theory, geometric representations of graphs / Directed graphs, posets / Metric graph theory / Spectral and algebraic graph theory / Random graphs, extremal graph theory / Matroids, oriented matroids, matroid minors / Algorithmic approaches
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts on structural, topological, spectral, extremal, random, matroidal, and algorithmic aspects of graphs and matroids fit this track; authors should make clear which sub-area(s) their results address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial processing expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: This journal will at all times ensure the efficient and speedy processing of submitted manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors can expect timely handling of submissions; while not a submission criterion, this signals editorial commitment to prompt review and decisions.
